messages.text: im in the loading bay till you finish
go home
ill go home when weve spoken
black astra by the bins, thats me
i can see it from the window
come down then, save us both the wait
you finish at 4 on wednesdays now dont you
how would you know that
ive been getting the same bus. hello by the way
your bedroom light was on at half one
stop driving down my road
its a road. i can drive down a road
whose van was outside yours last night
nothing to do with you
it is when its parked where mine used to go
im at the front, dont make a scene
i didnt ask you here
five minutes and ill go. or ill knock til the neighbours come out
brought your post round, theres loads
redirect it, dont bring it
im already on the step
your dad let me in, we had a brew
you went to my parents
they still think a lot of me. thats not my fault
before you block this one, hear me out
thats the fourth number
and ill get a fifth. sim cards are a fiver
guess who
i know exactly who
then stop blocking me and well both save the effort
lovely photo of you and the girls
this is a brand new account with no friends
you keep reporting the old ones. what did you expect
you were tagged at the arena. good night was it
why are you watching my tags
i dont have to watch, it comes up
unfollowed me but you still watch my stories
i dont
it tells me who watches. so thats a lie for a start
messaged your sister since you wont answer
leave her out of it
then dont make me go round the back way
spoke to karen at your work, shes worried about you
you told my colleague lies about me
i told her the truth. she can make her own mind up
your manager knows now
knows what
about the money. thought theyd want to
parcel coming tomorrow, dont refuse it
ill send it straight back
then ill send another. its only money
hi
hello
i can see the ticks
right
ok so were doing this again are we
22 missed calls isnt me being obsessive its me being worried
its half three in the morning
and youre awake, so answer
nobody will ever know you like i do
we were together four months
and ive thought about you every day since. that means something
i still have the ticket from our first night out
that was two years ago
i keep everything. one day youll see why
nice trainers, new?
how do you know what im wearing
i was behind you in the queue. you didnt notice
hows the new place, third floor is it
i never gave you my address
you didnt need to
one post and everyone at that club knows what you did
i didnt do anything
doesnt matter. mud sticks
so youve gone to the police
you left me no choice
and what do you think happens now
youre right, im sorry, ill stop
thanks, i mean it
can i just ask one thing though
if i dont hear from you tonight thats on you
dont put that on me
im just telling you how it is
your new fella seems nice, we had a chat
you contacted him
he had a right to know what hes getting
told the boys to ask you why youre being like this
dont use them
then talk to me and i wont have to
see youre still doing the thursday run club
you hate running
people change. see you thursday
the whole group thinks youre a joke, im just the one saying it

because someone should tell you the truth
put a filter on next time love
delete this
cant handle honesty can you
third time asking about that drink
and third time im saying no
youll change your mind, they always do
you look tired lately
who is this
someone who sees you more than you think
expect a call from the council about the dogs
you reported me
a concerned neighbour did
im going to keep pestering you til you come out, fair warning
honestly i might need the push
good. saturday, ill drive
ive got a box of your stuff, whats easiest
can you leave it at my mums
course. ill drop it sunday and thats me done
sorry to keep on, still need those numbers
today i promise
no rush beyond today, thanks
saw your light on late, everything alright?
couldnt sleep
knock if you need anything, im up early anyway
outside with your parcel, cant get an answer
leave it in the porch please
done, photo attached
i know youre cross with me but text me when youre home
alright
thank you. thats all i wanted
hes asked me to tell you hes sorry, thats all im doing, not getting involved

none of my business. pub friday?

not for me sorry
all good, take care
